description: Client-side script for the 'Pricing Rule' doctype in ERPNext, managing form setup, dynamic queries, help content, and field behaviors.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes form queries for 'for_price_list' and UOM fields based on 'apply_on' value.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Sets default 'applicable_for' and buying/selling flags based on whether the document is new and has customer or supplier.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Displays help content, sets options for 'applicable_for', and toggles required fields based on 'apply_on'.

methods.name: apply_on
methods.description: Triggers toggle of required fields when 'apply_on' changes.

methods.name: toggle_reqd_apply_on
methods.description: Sets required status for 'items', 'item_groups', 'brands' based on 'apply_on' value.

methods.name: selling
methods.description: Updates options for 'applicable_for' when 'selling' is toggled.

methods.name: buying
methods.description: Updates options for 'applicable_for' when 'buying' is toggled.

methods.name: margin_type
methods.description: Dynamically updates description of 'margin_rate_or_amount' based on 'margin_type'.

methods.name: set_options_for_applicable_for
methods.description: Sets options for 'applicable_for' field based on 'selling' and 'buying' flags.
